name: flow
description: A work hub for Claude Code: an orchestrator that plans and delegates to tiered workers, YAML workflows that mix scripts and Claude, and /flow-board to see and run them.

workflowsDir.title: Workflows folder
workflowsDir.description: Folder holding workflow folders (each with a flow.yaml). A .flows/ folder in the current project is read too.

autoOpen.title: Open the Agents tab
autoOpen.description: flow: open the flow chart on its Agents tab when flow workers start; any: for any subagent; off: only with /flow-agents.

bar.title: Progress bar
bar.description: always: keep the bar above the prompt in every chat, idle between flows; flow: only while a flow runs.
